children: Geojit Financial Services, Lumino Industries Ltd

Lumino Industries Ltd. (LIL), incorporated in 2005, is an integrated power infrastructure company engaged in both manufacturing and EPC operations. The company manufactures conductors, power cables, electrical wires and other transmission products, while also executing projects in power transmission & distribution, EHV substations, solar power, railway electrification and water management. Its business model provides better control over the supply chain and improves execution efficiency. Manufacturing remains the key revenue driver, contributing ~69.7% of FY26 revenue, while EPC contributed ~30.3%. • India's power transmission, renewable energy, electrification and wires & cables industries are witnessing a strong capex cycle. The domestic wires & cables market is expected to grow at ~13-14% CAGR through FY31, driven by transmission investments, renewable integration, rail electrification and infrastructure development.

At the upper price band of ₹82, Lumino is valued at ~15.6x FY26 earnings and ~11.7x FY26 EV/EBITDA, available at a discount to its listed peers. Supported by strong order-book visibility, an integrated manufacturing-EPC model, healthy return ratios, planned debt reduction and favorable industry tailwinds, we recommend a
rating for investors with a medium- to long-term investment horizon.
